name: @ggedde/spry-css
description: A simple and customizable CSS Toolkit while being as lightweight as possible
author: ggedde

scripts.build-with-postcss: node_modules/.bin/sass --style=compressed --no-source-map ./spry.scss | node_modules/.bin/postcss --map false -o ./dist/spry.min.css; cp ./dist/spry.min.css ./docs/spry.min.css; wc -c ./dist/spry.min.css | awk '{ total = int( ($1 / 1024) * 10) / 10; print total " KB"}' && gzip -c4 ./dist/spry.min.css | wc -c | awk '{ total = int( ($1 / 1024) * 10) / 10; print total " KB" }'
scripts.build: node_modules/.bin/sass --style=compressed --no-source-map ./spry.scss | node_modules/.bin/lightningcss -m -o ./dist/spry.min.css; cp ./dist/spry.min.css ./docs/spry.min.css; wc -c ./dist/spry.min.css | awk '{ total = int( ($1 / 1024) * 10) / 10; print total " KB"}' && gzip -c4 ./dist/spry.min.css | wc -c | awk '{ total = int( ($1 / 1024) * 10) / 10; print total " KB" }'
scripts.build-full: node_modules/.bin/sass ./spry.scss:./dist/spry.min.css; cp ./dist/spry.min.css ./docs/spry.min.css; cp ./dist/spry.min.css.map ./docs/spry.min.css.map; wc -c ./dist/spry.min.css | awk '{ total = int( ($1 / 1024) * 10) / 10; print total " KB"}' && gzip -c4 ./dist/spry.min.css | wc -c | awk '{ total = int( ($1 / 1024) * 10) / 10; print total " KB" }'
scripts.build-spry-js: node_modules/.bin/terser ./docs/spry.js --config-file .terser -o ./dist/spry.min.js; cp ./dist/spry.min.js ./docs/spry.min.js; wc -c ./dist/spry.min.js | awk '{ total = int( ($1 / 1024) * 10) / 10; print total " KB"}' && gzip -c4 ./dist/spry.min.js | wc -c | awk '{ total = int( ($1 / 1024) * 10) / 10; print total " KB" }'
scripts.build-docs-css: node_modules/.bin/postcss ./docs/docs.css --map false -o ./docs/docs.min.css; wc -c ./docs/docs.min.css | awk '{ total = int( ($1 / 1024) * 10) / 10; print total " KB"}' && gzip -c4 ./docs/docs.min.css | wc -c | awk '{ total = int( ($1 / 1024) * 10) / 10; print total " KB" }'
scripts.build-docs-js: node_modules/.bin/terser ./docs/docs.js --config-file .terser -o ./docs/docs.min.js; wc -c ./docs/docs.min.js | awk '{ total = int( ($1 / 1024) * 10) / 10; print total " KB"}' && gzip -c4 ./docs/docs.min.js | wc -c | awk '{ total = int( ($1 / 1024) * 10) / 10; print total " KB" }'
scripts.build-docs: npm run build-docs-css; npm run build-docs-js
